content.title: About
content.content: Chipotle yogurt dip is a spicy condiment made from natural yogurt, chipotle paste, lime juice, and seasonings. It combines the creamy texture of yogurt with the smoky flavor of chipotle, delivering a light heat and fresh tang to dishes.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Chipotle is a smoked, dried jalapeño pepper that gives the dip its distinctive smoky taste.
The yogurt base makes the dip lighter and richer in probiotics compared with traditional mayo‑based dips.
It is commonly served with nachos, tacos, vegetable sticks, and seafood in Mexican cuisine.
The combination of lime and chipotle balances acidity and spiciness, aiding digestion.
Low in fat, this dip fits well into diet‑friendly menus.

items.title: Probiotics
items.content: Yogurt provides live cultures that support a healthy gut microbiome.

items.title: Low Fat Content
items.content: Compared with mayo‑based sauces, this dip contains fewer calories and saturated fats.

items.title: Vitamin C
items.content: Lime adds vitamin C, which boosts immunity and acts as an antioxidant.

items.title: Capsaicin
items.content: Chipotle contains capsaicin, which may boost metabolism and has anti‑inflammatory properties.

items.title: Calcium and Protein
items.content: Yogurt supplies calcium and plant‑based protein, beneficial for bones and muscles.

items.title: Lactose Intolerance
items.content: People with lactose intolerance may experience discomfort from the yogurt.

items.title: Spiciness
items.content: The dip can be too hot for children or individuals with sensitive stomachs.

items.title: Dairy Allergy
items.content: Those allergic to dairy should avoid this product.

items.title: Sodium Content
items.content: Some versions contain added salt; individuals with hypertension should monitor portion size.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve with nachos, tortillas, vegetable sticks, seafood, chicken wings, or use as a salad dressing. It also works well in sandwiches and burgers for an extra kick.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep refrigerated at 1 °C–4 °C in a sealed container. Once opened, consume within 5–7 days. Discard if it develops off‑odors or discoloration.
